title: 第17章 开个小会第18章 新时代的铁与血
slug: 军事公主不会爱上魔法科学家
lines: 三天后。
凛冬城的广场上挤满了人。
高台两侧站满了衣着华丽的贵族，他们脸上挂着客套的笑，眼里却满是算计。市民和士兵被隔在外围，踮着脚往里看，交头接耳的议论着新来的公主。
“听说她才二十二岁？”
“能行吗？大公阁下那么厉害的人都快撑不住了。”
“谁知道呢，反正咱们也就看个热闹。”
洛加里斯双手插兜，站在人群后的阴影里，镜片反射着广场的光。
莉莉丝缩在他身边，小声问：“教授大人，您说公主殿下能镇住这些老狐狸吗？”
“别废话。”洛加里斯没看她，“看着就行。”
典礼开始了。
阿卡什率领的仪仗队踏着整齐的步伐入场，军靴踩在石板上，发出沉闷的响声。
接着，瑟薇娅出现了。
她穿着芬里尔留下的旧式军装，外面披着黑貂皮斗篷。头发高高盘起，露出白皙的脖颈，侧脸线条冷峻。
腰间别着那柄冬狼之牙短剑。
她一步步走上高台，银灰色的眼睛扫过台下的每一张脸。
台下的议论声渐渐小了下去。
瑟薇娅站在台上，沉默几秒，然后开了口。
“我是瑟薇娅·凡·阿斯特利亚。”
她的声音不大，却清晰的传遍了广场每个角落。
“从今天起，我接管北境的一切事务。”
“我不会说什么漂亮话。北境现在很穷，很乱，很弱。这是事实。”
台下的贵族们面面相觑。
这公主说话怎么这么直白？
“但这不会是永远。”瑟薇娅继续说，“我会让北境变强，变富，变成所有人都没办法小看的地方。”
“至于怎么做，我会用行动来证明。”
她顿了顿，目光锐利的扫过台下的贵族。
“各位，请拭目以待。”
说完，她转身走下高台。
广场上安静了几秒，然后响起了零零散散的掌声。
那掌声稀稀拉拉的，透着一股敷衍。
洛加里斯推了推眼镜，嘴角扯出一个冷笑。
“还真是一群不见棺材不掉泪的东西。”
莉莉丝小声问：“教授，公主殿下的演讲……好像没什么用啊。”
“有用？”洛加里斯瞥了她一眼，“她要的从来就不是掌声。”
夜幕降临。
公爵府的会议厅里灯火通明。
长长的会议桌两边坐满了人，都是北境有头有脸的贵族和官员。
瑟薇娅坐在主位，面前摊着一叠文件。
content_en:
Three days later.
The square in Winter City was crowded with people.
Both sides of the high platform were filled with nobles in gorgeous clothes. They had polite smiles on their faces, but their eyes were full of calculations. The citizens and soldiers were separated from the outside, looking in on tiptoes, whispering about the new princess.
"I heard that she is only twenty-two years old?"
"Is it possible? A man as powerful as His Excellency the Grand Duke can hardly hold on."
"Who knows, anyway, we just want to watch the excitement."
Logaris stood in the shadow behind the crowd with his hands in his pockets, his lenses reflecting the light of the square.
Lilith shrank beside him and asked in a low voice: "Professor, do you think Her Royal Highness can control these old foxes?"
"Don't talk nonsense." Logaris didn't look at her, "Just watch."
The ceremony began.
The honor guard led by Akash entered the room in neat steps, and their military boots made a dull sound when they stepped on the stone slabs.
Then, Sylvia appeared.
She wore Fenrir's old military uniform with a sable cloak. Her hair was tied up high, revealing her white neck, and her profile was stern.
At his waist was the Winter Wolf's Fang dagger.
She walked up to the stage step by step, her silver-grey eyes scanning every face under the stage.
The discussion in the audience gradually died down.
Serviya stood on the stage, remained silent for a few seconds, and then spoke.
"I am Sylvia Van Astraea."
Her voice was not loud, but it spread clearly to every corner of the square.
"From today on, I will take over all affairs in the North."
"I won't say anything nice. The North is poor, chaotic and weak now. This is a fact."
The nobles in the audience looked at each other.
Why does this princess speak so straightforwardly?
"But it won't be forever." Serviya continued, "I will make the North stronger and richer, and become a place that no one can underestimate."
"As for how to do it, I will prove it with actions."
She paused and glanced sharply at the nobles in the audience.
"Everyone, please wait and see."
After saying that, she turned around and walked off the platform.
The square was quiet for a few seconds, and then scattered applause broke out.
The applause was sparse and seemed perfunctory.
Logaris pushed up his glasses and sneered at the corner of his mouth.
"They are really a bunch of people who won't shed tears until they see the coffin."
Lilith asked in a low voice: "Professor, Her Royal Highness the Princess's speech... seems to be of no use."
"Useful?" Logaris glanced at her, "She never wanted applause."
Night falls.
The meeting hall of the Duke's Palace was brightly lit.
Both sides of the long conference table were filled with people, all of whom were prominent nobles and officials from the north.
Serviya sat in the main seat with a stack of documents spread out in front of her.
